name: Misty Forest Entrance
desc:
The edge of the forest shrouded in thick fog. The ancient trees are towering and the gray mist is flowing.
The path leads deep into the forest (north), with an abandoned hut to the west (west), and the ruins of a tower to the south (south).
An old man stood with a shovel next to the tombstone, as if waiting for something.

name: abandoned cabin
desc:
A dilapidated wooden house with half the roof collapsed. There is an iron box in the corner and a lantern on the table.
There seems to be something moving in the corner...

name: dark forest
desc:
Getting darker. The ancient trees are twisted and there are shadows in the fog. There are wolves howling in the distance.
There appears to be an abandoned cemetery to the west, leading to a cave to the north and a crossroads to the east.

name: cave entrance
desc: The dark cave entrance was filled with gloomy wind. There are notches on the cave walls. There is a passage down.

name: middle level of cave
desc:
Natural cave hall with cracks above that allow light to pass through. The cave walls glow with moss.
Multiple passages lead in different directions.

name: Deep in the cave
desc:
The deepest part of the cave has a pungent smell. There are bones on the ground.
A giant spider spins a web in the corner...

name: ancient ruins
desc:
The stone chamber has relief carvings on the walls. The central stone platform has velvet cushions.
The stone door on the north wall is locked and requires a rusty key.

name: secret passage
desc:
The narrow passage allows only one person to pass through. There are glowing runes on the walls.
There is an upward staircase at the end of the passage.

name: crossroads
desc: A forest clearing where five roads intersect. Street sign: ←Lake | North: Tower | South: Forest | East: ←

name: bottom of tower
desc: An ancient stone tower covered with vines. The tower door is tightly closed, and the shape of the keyhole matches the silver key.

name: middle floor of tower
desc:
The circular hall in the tower has ancient tapestries hanging on the walls.
The spiral staircase continues upward.

name: top of tower
desc:
Tower top room! Filled with books and magical implements. There is endless fog outside the window.
There is a sparkling magic gem on the central desk. But a baby dragon is sitting next to the gem!

name: lakeside
desc:
Quiet lake with clear water. Small wooden boats float on the lake.
There is a small village to the south. An old man carrying a bow was fishing by the lake.

name: lakeside village
desc:
Quiet little fishing village. There are several wooden houses with smoke curling up.
There is a notice posted on the bulletin board at the entrance of the village. The village has a tavern, a blacksmith shop and a temple.

name: island in the center of the lake
desc:
There are temple ruins on the island. The gems on the altar are protected by a magical barrier.
It can be reached by ferry from the pier. There are shadows swimming in the water...

name: goblin lair
desc:
The smell from the buttocks and nose hits my face! The cave was filled with stolen debris and bones.
A group of goblins are dividing the spoils. When they see you, they scream and rush over!

name: Goblin Throne
desc:
A natural stone temple in the deepest part of the cave. A giant goblin sits on a pile of bones.
It wears a bone crown on its head, and the giant stick in its hand is still stained with blood - this is the Goblin King!

name: underground river
desc:
The cave suddenly opened up here, and a dark underground river slowly flowed through.
There was glowing moss like fireflies on the river bank, and something was swimming in the water...

name: frozen cave
desc:
The walls of the cave were covered with thick frost and the temperature plummeted.
The breath he exhaled instantly condensed into white mist, and the ground was frozen and very slippery.
A creature made of ice crystals stands still in the corner...until it sees you.

name: hidden trees
desc:
A secluded clearing surrounded by ancient trees. The sun casts dappled light and shadow through the leaves.
There is a stone altar in the center of the clearing, surrounded by glowing herbs.
The air is filled with the scent of flowers and magic.

name: bandit camp
desc:
In a clearing deep in the forest, there were several simple tents. The bonfire is still burning.
Several ferocious-looking robbers are dividing the loot, and when they see you, they all draw their weapons!

name: Robber's Treasure Room
desc:
The robbers' secret treasure room! Piles filled with looted property.
There's a giant treasure chest in the corner...is it breathing? !

name: Misty Tavern
desc:
The warm tavern smelled of ale and barbecue. The fire was burning brightly in the fireplace.
Various prey heads hang on the walls, and a few locals drink and chat in the corner.

name: blacksmith shop
desc:
The hot furnace and the clanking of hammers. The walls are covered with various weapons and armor.
The temperature is much higher than outside.

name: Temple of Light
desc:
A small and solemn temple. Stained glass windows let in a soft glow.
The smell of incense fills the air, which is soothing.

name: alchemist's laboratory
desc:
A cave laboratory filled with strange instruments and bottles.
Colorful liquids boiled in the flasks, filling the air with a pungent smell.

name: forest tower ruins
desc:
An ancient stone tower, half collapsed, covered in vines and moss.
The spiral staircase inside the tower is broken, but there appears to be space underground.
A giant eagle built its nest on top of the tower.

name: Cursed Cemetery
desc:
A desolate cemetery with tombstones stuck crookedly in the soil.
The cold wind whimpered through the dead trees. Something is moving under the ground...
At the end of the cemetery, there is a stone door entangled with vines. The groove shape matches the magic gem guarded by the young dragon on the top of the tower.
A black-armored mercenary was searching for something in the cemetery.

name: Containment site access control
desc:
At the end of the concrete hallway is a heavy airtight door, with a faded Foundation logo taped to the wall.
Magical gems resonated here, opening the way to the depths of the containment site.

name: Security command hall
desc: The command hall is full of surveillance screens, and most of the equipment has been powered off. Abandoned armor boxes were piled in the corner.

name: containment corridor
desc:
There are vaguely numbered containment units on both sides, and most of the doors are twisted and deformed.
The south side leads to the unit area, and the faint sound of gears can be heard downwards - that's No. 914.

name: Archives
desc: Among the collapsed bookshelves, a terminal was still playing a warning video in a loop. The musty smell of paper hung in the air.

name: Out of control containment room
desc: The containment pillar in the center of the room has shattered, and a pulsing abnormal core is suspended in the air. Warning lights on the walls flashed wildly.

name: Containment unit area
desc: Damaged nameplates hung on both sides of the corridor: 012, 096, 173, 049...the warning lights were still flashing.

name: Gear Workshop (SCP-ZH-914)
desc:
Huge clockwork machinery dominates the hall. The feed hopper and gear plate are in good condition.
Nameplate: Rough / 1:1 / Fine / Very Fine.
Type use 914 to attempt to refine a non-quest item in your backpack.

name: Unit 012
desc: Blood-stained music scores were nailed to the music stand behind the glass. The whisper compels you to come closer.

name: Unit 096
desc: Thickened soundproof room. The surveillance was scratched. Sitting in the corner was a pale figure covering his face with his hands.

name: Unit 173
desc: The empty holding cell has scratches and stains on the floor. The sculpture faces the door - you'd swear it wasn't there just now.

name: Endless Stairs (SCP-ZH-087)
desc: The concrete stairs lead downwards to no end. There was a faint cry from below.

name: Stairs deeper
desc: The lights were almost out. The face is stuck to the lower corner...or maybe it's just a stain.

name: corrosion corridor
desc: The walls oozed black corrosive liquid, and the footprints disappeared into the solid wall.

name: Flesh Room (SCP-ZH-002)
desc: The spherical chamber is covered with veins and tendons, and the furniture is made of bones.

name: Isolation ward
desc: Abandoned medical area, the air smells of formalin. The plague doctor stood beside the bed.

name: Happy isolation room
desc: In the padded room, orange gumballs were bouncing merrily.

name: Server Room (SCP-ZH-079)
desc: The rack roars. The screen of an antique computer lights up: WAITING…

name: living room
desc: A cozy reception room that doesn’t fit the style of the site. Fireplaces, sofas, and tea sets are all available.

name: Coffee Lounge (SCP-ZH-294)
desc: In the corner stands a coffee machine that can serve any drink. The panel says: Enter use 294.

name: Dimensional vending machine arcade (SCP-ZH-261)
desc: Strange vending machines spit out snacks with unknown packaging. The coin slot shines: use 261.

name: Monitoring Room (SCP-ZH-895)
desc: The screen shows a close-up of a coffin. The more you look at it, the more you feel like the picture is looking at you.

name: Conference Room 073
desc: Simple meeting room. The man with the mark on his forehead sat quietly.

name: Sarcophagus Chamber (SCP-ZH-076)
desc: The black sarcophagus was half-open, and the ground was covered with knife marks.

name: Acid Pond No. 682
desc: Huge acid containment tank. Something is moving beneath the surface - the undying hatred is still there. There is a sealed black door on the east side, with the number "001" written out and rewritten.

name: No. 001 Final Storage Vault
desc: There is nothing inside the black door, but it seems to be crowded with eyes. The only label left is "001". The air was as thick as asphalt—the end of Site Operations.

name: Endless store channel (SCP-ZH-3008)
desc: Warehouse-style shelves extend to the end of the field of view. Broadcast reminder: Night is about to begin.

name: Egg Storage Room (SCP-ZH-3199)
desc: The freezer cracked, and slime and empty shells were scattered all over the floor.

name: multithroated lair
desc: A familiar cry for help came from the darkness. The voice doesn't sound right.

name: lightless hunting grounds
desc: The infrared indicator light is damaged. You feel something waiting in the rhythm of your breathing.

name: Detector's Storehouse
desc: On the charging stand, two eyeball robots rolled around excitedly.

name: Light blocking cabinet
desc: A vault surrounded by bright lights. Shadows writhe between lampposts.

name: Tower foyer
desc:
Behind the tower door opened by the silver key is a tall stone foyer.
The armory in the west wing, the library in the east wing, and the spiral staircase continues upward.

name: Tower Armory
desc: The iron racks were hung with rusty weapons and shields.

name: tower library
desc: Towering bookshelves reach to the ceiling. An old scholar was reading ancient books by candlelight.

name: tower chapel
desc: The long and narrow chapel has a heavy stone door on the north side leading to the ceremony room.

name: tower observatory
desc: In the circular star observation room, the brass telescope points to the cracks in the dome, and there is endless gray fog outside the window.

name: tower cell
desc: A dark and damp cell. An old man wearing a worn monk's robe sat cross-legged in the corner.

name: Tower Ceremony Room
desc: The ground is engraved with magic circles, and the eyes of the central stone statue light up - the crystal door leading to the top of the tower is locked.

name: Goblin Cave
desc: Goblin shacks were dug on both sides of the narrow corridor, and the stench was overwhelming.

name: spider lair
desc: The cave walls and ground were covered with sticky spider webs, and giant spiders were scurrying around in the darkness.

name: Crystal Corridor
desc: Ice blue crystals hang from the ceiling, the light refracting into thousands of colored bands.

name: Flooded Temple
desc: The underground river flows into the ancient temple, and the statue of the water god is half submerged in the water.

name: Mushroom Cave
desc: Giant mushrooms line the streets, and fluorescent fungi illuminate the winding paths.

name: fungus garden
desc: Glowing fungi live in symbiosis with magical herbs, and the air is filled with floral fragrance.

name: Echo Hall
desc: In the huge empty hall, the sound of footsteps was amplified into a thunderous echo.

name: collapsed tunnel
desc: The tunnel was blocked by falling rocks, leaving only a narrow gap to pass through.

name: misty trail
desc: Thick fog moved over the trail, and visibility was less than ten steps.

name: wolf lair
desc: In the caves covered by the rocks, several pairs of green eyes stare at you in the darkness.

name: old mill
desc: Abandoned wooden mill, water wheel half sunk in dry ditch.

name: ferry terminal
desc: A wooden dock stretches out into the lake, and the ferry sways gently on its pilings.

name: hunter cabin
desc: The walls are covered with animal skins and bows and arrows, and the old man is cleaning his hunting knife.

name: abandoned chapel
desc: Most of the roof of the stone chapel collapsed, and the priestess in white prayed in front of the broken altar.
